basis: P04 requires five actual seconds of dragging, frame coalescing, unchanged-size suppression, correct final geometry and no sustained main-process blocking.

Duplicate size suppression and nonzero dimensions are direct behavioral requirements. Frame count is an aggregate App bound with two boundary messages; exact coalescing is additionally verified with a deterministic scheduler, not inferred from aggregate timing alone.

250ms maximum event-loop lag and 100 samples at 25ms are pre-execution engineering gates for this local fixture, not observed Codex performance or a general all-device SLA. No minimum display refresh rate is invented.
budget.changePolicy: Preserve E1 and failures. Do not loosen a gate to count the current execution as passed.
